      "skill_change": "Enforce fact-preserving memory ingestion: apply rule-based or NER-guided segmentation to extract and store atomic, self-contained factual statements (e.g., 'Melanie painted a sunrise in 2022', 'John practices kickboxing and taekwondo', 'Caroline is pursuing psychology and counseling certification', 'Joanna first watched Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind in 2019') — discarding non-factual chit-chat fragments.",
      "target_pattern": "memory_quality_failure"
    }
